:::{#def-induced-norm}
#### Induced norm (norm induced by an inner product)

In an [inner product space](#def-inner-product-space) $(V, \iprod{\cdot}{\cdot})$,
the **induced norm** (or **norm induced by** $\iprod{\cdot}{\cdot}$)
is the [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function)
that maps each vector $\vx \in V$
to the [square root](algebra.qmd#def-square-root) of the inner product of $\vx$ with itself:

$$\norm{\vx} \eqdef \sqrt{\iprod{\vx}{\vx}}$$ {#eq-induced-norm}

:::
